vibe: Romantic, intimate, elegant, moody, cinematic. Like a Michelin-star dining invitation.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-none text-[#FAF9F6] drop-shadow-md
hierarchy.subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-light tracking-wide text-[#B8B1A8] mt-4 mb-10 leading-relaxed
hierarchy.button_tertiary: text-sm font-sans font-medium text-[#B8B1A8] hover:text-[#FAF9F6] transition-colors

layout.strategy: Mobile-first, cinematic poster layout. Content anchored to the bottom-left to allow the hero image to breathe and act as negative space.
layout.container: relative h-[100dvh] w-full overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end p-6 sm:p-12 pb-16 sm:pb-20
layout.spacing: gap-4 for buttons, mt-8 for separating text and actions.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned content block in the lower third. Breaks the standard 'centered invitation' cliché.

button_a.style: w-full bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0A0A0A] rounded-sm py-4 px-6 flex items-center justify-between shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)] hover:bg-[#E6C255] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

button_b.style: w-full bg-transparent border border-[#FAF9F6]/20 text-[#FAF9F6] backdrop-blur-md rounded-sm py-4 px-6 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-[#FAF9F6]/10 transition-all duration-300

button_c.style: w-full mt-2 py-3 text-center opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300

success_state.style: flex flex-col items-start gap-4 p-6 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-sm
success_state.text: Takk for svar. Svaret er sendt. Gleder meg til å snakkes mer!

motion.page_load: Framer Motion: Fade in background image slowly (1.5s). Staggered fade-up (y: 20 -> 0) for heading, subtitle, and buttons with 0.2s delay between each.
motion.interaction: Micro-interactions: Buttons scale to 0.98 on tap/click. Smooth color transitions (0.3s ease).
motion.state_change: Crossfade layout transition (AnimatePresence) when buttons are clicked and the success state appears.

images.description: Ultra-luxury intimate sushi bar interior, candlelit, dark moody ambiance. Acts as the full-bleed background for the entire app.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the gradient overlay is dark enough at the bottom (opacity 0.8 to 1) so the Ivory text meets APCA contrast standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the entrance animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind CSS configuration to include the custom colors and fonts (Cormorant Garamond and Manrope). Include links to Google Fonts in index.html.
Use Framer Motion for all staggered entrances and the success state transition.
The layout must be a relative full-screen container (h-[100dvh]) with the generated background image covering it completely (object-cover).
Add a div with the linear-gradient overlay from transparent at the top to almost solid black at the bottom.
Place the content container absolute at the bottom left, taking full width minus padding.
Implement states for 'idle' (showing the invitation), 'loading' (simulating Telegram send), and 'success' (showing the thank you message).
Ensure all buttons have the required data-testid attributes for testing.
